mod.name: TB Second Hand Market
mod.summary: A player-run market. Players place stalls, list offers and orders and trade items and vehicles with each other, with a bulletin board, global stalls and premium perks.
mod.notes: The documentation page for the item whitelist reads like a copy of the blacklist page; its behaviour is unverified.

files.title: Bulletin board
files.summary: Navigation and posting prices of the board.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

enableNavigation.label: Allow navigation to stalls
enableNavigation.help: Lets players start navigation to a market stall from the bulletin board.

showMapForMarketStallPositions.label: Show stall map
showMapForMarketStallPositions.help: Shows a map of stall positions on the bulletin board.

maxNavigationDistance.label: Max navigation distance
maxNavigationDistance.help: Greatest distance a player can navigate to a stall. -1 means any distance.

priceForPublishOnBulletinBoard.label: Price to publish
priceForPublishOnBulletinBoard.help: Cost for a normal player to post an offer on the board. -1 makes it free.

premiumPriceForPublishOnBulletinBoard.label: Premium price to publish
premiumPriceForPublishOnBulletinBoard.help: Cost for a premium player to post an offer. -1 makes it free.

files.title: Global stalls
files.summary: Placement of the shared global market stalls.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

dealerPoints.label: Global stalls
dealerPoints.help: The global market stalls placed in the world, shared by all players.

dealerPoints[].id.label: Storage id
dealerPoints[].id.help: Id of the stall storage. Stalls with the same id share one storage.

dealerPoints[].position.label: Position
dealerPoints[].position.help: World position [X, Y, Z] of the global stall.

dealerPoints[].position[].label: Coordinate value
dealerPoints[].position[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

dealerPoints[].orientation.label: Orientation
dealerPoints[].orientation.help: Facing of the stall as three angles in degrees.

dealerPoints[].orientation[].label: Angle value
dealerPoints[].orientation[].help: One angle of a three-value orientation, in degrees.

dealerPoints[].useExactPosition.label: Use exact position
dealerPoints[].useExactPosition.help: 0 places the stall on the ground below; 1 uses the coordinates as given.

dealerPoints[].type.label: Stall object
dealerPoints[].type.help: Class name of the stall object.

dealerPoints[].uniqueName.label: Stall name
dealerPoints[].uniqueName.help: Name for this stall, used in admin tools and lists.

dealerPoints[].disableVehicleTrading.label: Block vehicle trading
dealerPoints[].disableVehicleTrading.help: 1 stops normal players trading vehicles at this stall.

dealerPoints[].premiumDisableVehicleTrad.label: Block vehicle trading (premium)
dealerPoints[].premiumDisableVehicleTrad.help: 1 stops premium players trading vehicles at this stall.

files.title: General settings
files.summary: Premium switch, vehicle search distance and item condition limit.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

enablePremiumFeature.label: Premium features
enablePremiumFeature.help: Turns premium player features (bigger limits, lower prices) on or off.

maxSearchDistanceToVehicle.label: Vehicle search distance
maxSearchDistanceToVehicle.help: How far from the stall a vehicle may be when ordering vehicle items.

minOrderHealthValue.label: Minimum item condition
minOrderHealthValue.help: Worst condition an item can have in an order. Values run from Pristine through Worn and Damaged to BadlyDamaged and Ruined. Write them as in the existing file (the documentation spells one as "Badly Damaged"; the generated file uses BadlyDamaged).

files.title: Global stall rules
files.summary: Slots, prices, lifetimes and taxes at global stalls.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

pricePerSlot.label: Price per slot
pricePerSlot.help: What a player pays per slot used at the global stall. See the percentage switch.

pricePerSlotIsInPercentage.label: Slot price is a percentage
pricePerSlotIsInPercentage.help: 1 reads the slot price as a percentage instead of coins.

pricePerSlotPremiumPlayerIsInPercentage.label: Premium slot price is a percentage
pricePerSlotPremiumPlayerIsInPercentage.help: 1 reads the premium slot price as a percentage.

freeSlotsForPlayer.label: Free slots
freeSlotsForPlayer.help: Slots a normal player gets without paying.

maxSlotsForPlayer.label: Max slots
maxSlotsForPlayer.help: Most slots a normal player can have across all global stalls.

freeSlotsForPremiumPlayer.label: Free slots (premium)
freeSlotsForPremiumPlayer.help: Slots a premium player gets without paying.

maxSlotsForPremiumPlayer.label: Max slots (premium)
maxSlotsForPremiumPlayer.help: Most slots a premium player can have.

maxOrderLifetimeInMinutes.label: Order lifetime
maxOrderLifetimeInMinutes.help: How long an order stays active after creation.

maxOfferLifetimeInMinutes.label: Offer lifetime
maxOfferLifetimeInMinutes.help: How long an offer stays active after creation.

sellTaxInPercentageOrder.label: Tax on orders
sellTaxInPercentageOrder.help: Percent the seller pays when filling an order at a global stall. A coin sink.

sellTaxInPercentageOffer.label: Tax on offers
sellTaxInPercentageOffer.help: Percent paid when an offer is completed.

resetLifetimeOfOrderAfterUpdate.label: Reset order lifetime on update
resetLifetimeOfOrderAfterUpdate.help: Updating an order restarts its lifetime.

canResetLifetimeOfOrder.label: Players may reset order lifetime
canResetLifetimeOfOrder.help: Lets players restart the order timer by hand.

canResetLifetimeOfOffer.label: Players may reset offer lifetime
canResetLifetimeOfOffer.help: Lets players restart the offer timer by hand.

itemMaxPrices.help: Price caps for single items; they override the global cap.

itemMaxPrices[].itemType.label: Item class
itemMaxPrices[].itemType.help: Class name of the item the cap applies to.

itemMaxPrices[].maxPrice.label: Price cap
itemMaxPrices[].maxPrice.help: Highest price allowed for this item.

IsEnabled.help: When 1, the whitelist is used. Judging by the file layout only listed items can then be traded; the documentation page is ambiguous (it describes the list as blocking), so test on a copy first.

whiteListItems.help: Class names or patterns (Start*, *End, *part*) of items on the whitelist.

logBuyStallCSV.label: CSV log: stall purchases
logBuyStallCSV.help: Writes a line to a CSV file whenever a stall is bought.

logBuyStallDiscord.label: Discord log: stall purchases
logBuyStallDiscord.help: Posts a message whenever a stall is bought, to the address below.

discordBuyStallWebhookURL.label: Discord webhook address
discordBuyStallWebhookURL.help: Web address that stall purchases are posted to when the matching Discord switch is on. Treat it like a password: anyone holding it can post to that channel. Leave empty if you do not use it.
discordBuyStallWebhookURL.risk: A wrong or revoked address silently loses the messages.

files.title: Player stalls
files.summary: Stall limits, placement areas and the stall types players can buy.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

maxMarketStallPerUser.label: Stalls per player
maxMarketStallPerUser.help: Most stalls one player can have. -1 means unlimited.

maxPremiumMarketStallPerUser.label: Stalls per premium player
maxPremiumMarketStallPerUser.help: Most stalls for a premium player. -1 means unlimited.

maxMarketStallPerServer.label: Stalls on the server
maxMarketStallPerServer.help: Most stalls on the whole server. -1 means unlimited.

timeInMinutesThatOwnerHasAfterLifetimeIs.label: Grace period after expiry
timeInMinutesThatOwnerHasAfterLifetimeIs.help: Time the owner has to collect items once a stall expires.

playerCanOnlyPlaceMarketStallInWhitelist.label: Only place in whitelist areas
playerCanOnlyPlaceMarketStallInWhitelist.help: 1 limits stall placement to the whitelist areas. Do not switch on together with the blacklist option.

whitelistAreas.label: Whitelist areas
whitelistAreas.help: Circular areas where stalls may be placed.

whitelistAreas[].position.label: Area position
whitelistAreas[].position.help: Centre of the area [X, Y, Z].

whitelistAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate value
whitelistAreas[].position[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

playerCanOnlyPlaceMarketStallInNonBlackl.label: Block blacklist areas
playerCanOnlyPlaceMarketStallInNonBlackl.help: 1 stops stall placement inside the blacklist areas. Do not switch on together with the whitelist option.

blacklistAreas.label: Blacklist areas
blacklistAreas.help: Circular areas where stalls may not be placed.

blacklistAreas[].position.label: Area position
blacklistAreas[].position.help: Centre of the area [X, Y, Z].

blacklistAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate value
blacklistAreas[].position[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

stalls.label: Stall types
stalls.help: The stall types players can buy and place, with their sizes, lifetimes and prices.

stalls[].id.label: Stall id
stalls[].id.help: Unique id for this stall type; any random text.

stalls[].type.label: Stall kit class
stalls[].type.help: Class name of the stall kit item.

stalls[].premiumExtraLifetimeInMinutes.label: Extra lifetime (premium)
stalls[].premiumExtraLifetimeInMinutes.help: Minutes added to the lifetime for premium players.

stalls[].premiumPriceReduce.label: Premium discount
stalls[].premiumPriceReduce.help: Amount taken off the price for premium players.

stalls[].priceForTimeExtension.label: Extension price
stalls[].priceForTimeExtension.help: Cost to extend the lifetime. -1 turns extensions off.

stalls[].durationInMinutesForTimeExtensi.label: Extension length
stalls[].durationInMinutesForTimeExtensi.help: Minutes added per extension. -1 turns extensions off.

stalls[].disableVehicleTrading.label: Block vehicle trading
stalls[].disableVehicleTrading.help: 1 stops normal players trading vehicles at this stall.

stalls[].premiumDisableVehicleTrading.label: Block vehicle trading (premium)
stalls[].premiumDisableVehicleTrading.help: 1 stops premium players trading vehicles at this stall.
